name: Выводок
alt: Пять маленьких зелёных монстриков выстроились за одним большим печеньем.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: Exactly FIVE small round green baby fantasy monsters, each with two tiny arms two feet and one pair of stubby horns, clustered eagerly around one giant cookie on a stone. Different silly faces, one sitting atop cookie, others neatly separated around it. Clear count and silhouettes, no extra heads or limbs, warm comic menace, no text.
